title: The directory tape (NAME-dir-pages-of: one (offset, width) record per row) must persist in the catalog root r-cat beside the rows: the commit appends one record (an append-dirty at the directory's end, at most 2 pages), and a withdrawal that ESCAPES a row (PCK-ADOPT-ESCAPED) changes that row's width and so shifts every later offset in the directory. Owed: fn-pck-adopt-is-the-catalog gains the directory image and its commit delta; PCK-ADOPT-ESCAPED's widening statement covers the directory suffix.
